final_report.summary: Within the authorized window (1789010952–1789011252) the failing dependency on the POST /api/checkout path is the checkout → payment gRPC call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, which fails with rpc.grpc.status_code 2 (UNKNOWN), propagating up as CheckoutService/PlaceOrder code 13 and frontend/proxy HTTP 500. Checkout's client-side histogram counts show ~11.3 window increase for Charge at status 2 and 0 at status 0 (m002-fault-01-e11, m002-fault-01-e15); payment service spans show equal STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET increases (~12.55) while app_payment_transactions_total shows 0 window increase (m002-fault-01-e13, m002-fault-01-e16). No payment logs exist in the accessible log backend. The trigger/mechanism of the Charge failure (e.g. payment-side error or config) is not observable in the permitted telemetry and is left as an open gap; no hidden configuration trigger is inferred.

claims.text: Observed frontend-proxy access log shows "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 at 2026-09-10T03:33:49.943Z with trace_id 124bb098579844844530eaab40293ff1; 19 of 20 displayed rows are visible and the surrounding visible rows are 200s.

Sampled spans for trace 490fdb46cfa2ce55c61bbe602016604e show an observed parent-child chain: load-generator POST (error, http.status_code 500) → frontend-proxy ingress/router egress → frontend POST /api/checkout (500) → frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13) → checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13); the checkout span is the deepest errored span in the returned sample.

In the window increase of checkout's client histogram counts, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge shows ~11.30 at rpc_grpc_status_code 2 and 0 at status 0, while other checkout client calls (GetProduct, GetCart, GetQuote, Convert) are entirely status 0 — the Charge call is the only failing client call attributed to checkout.
Checkout's server-side PlaceOrder counts show ~11.30 at rpc_grpc_status_code 13 and 0 at status 0, consistent with all counted PlaceOrder server calls in the window failing.

Payment service span metrics show equal STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET window increases (~12.55) with no further breakdown, and no payment-side rpc_method/labels were returned by traces; the returned sampled trace spans include no payment span.

app_payment_transactions_total is nonzero cumulatively (USD 77, CAD 6, service_version 2.0.2) but its window increase over 5m is 0 for both currencies, i.e. no completed payment transactions were counted in the window despite Charge attempts occurring.

Error increases are confined to the checkout path: frontend-proxy STATUS_CODE_ERROR ~25.1, frontend ERROR ~37.7, checkout ERROR ~25.1, payment ERROR ~12.6, load-generator ERROR ~12.6; product-catalog, cart, currency, quote, shipping and ad show no error-tagged increase in the window.

cart service logs in the window are all Information-level GetCartAsync/AddItemAsync entries with no error-level records, and the checkout-path trace 124bb098579844844530eaab40293ff1 includes cart activity returning HTTP 200 — cart is not the failing dependency.
The log backend returned zero records for service payment in the window (backend_total_hits 0), so payment's own error messages are not observable.
The checkout → payment Charge call is the failing dependency causing the POST /api/checkout HTTP 500s, with gRPC status 2 (UNKNOWN) returned by payment and surfaced by checkout as status 13.

Payment is reached but its Charge handler fails before recording a transaction, since payment error spans increase while app_payment_transactions_total shows no window increase; the internal cause inside payment (business rejection, downstream dependency, or application error) is not visible in the permitted telemetry.

Payment's own client histogram metric for its service_name returned no series (empty result), so there is no observed outgoing call edge from payment to any further dependency; the failing call's origin cannot be extended beyond checkout → payment.

Complete call chain cannot be asserted: the trace query returned only 20 spans of 349 total (omitted_span_count 335), selected error-first then longest-duration, so intermediate or deeper spans (including any payment span) were not shown and remain unknown.
The frontend-proxy log view is not an exhaustive error inventory: backend_total_hits was 180 while 19 rows were model-visible; status claims apply only to the displayed rows.

Cart as the failing dependency is rejected: cart logs in the window contain only Information-level GetCartAsync/AddItemAsync entries with no errors, cart has no error-tagged span increase, and the error trace's cart calls returned 200.

Advisory: inspect the payment service instance (compose service payment, container_id 8d8e65e2ed9f99ddf60b05d230eff40c68dc66a7afbd434ac6b959d122286571, image sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87, config_hash a95bfc14611fdb08ca0326d1cb424656f71473949db0dcba9d52341402583bb6) and its Charge handler error output, since payment's own logs are not in the accessible log backend.

Advisory: where an error status drives a CEL/flagd-style routing or retry, capture the payment-side error response body/status message for charge failures; the mechanism behind gRPC status 2 from Charge is not observable in the permitted telemetry and is not diagnosed here (no hidden configuration trigger inferred).

gaps: Payment's own application logs and error messages for Charge are absent (backend_total_hits 0), so the internal failure mechanism inside payment is unknown.
Only 20 of 349 spans were returned (335 omitted) by an error-biased, duration-biased sampler; the complete call chain and any payment span are not observed.
The reported error spans for payment are all STATUS_CODE_ERROR with no rpc_method breakdown in traces, so which payment handler/operation produced them is not visible.
The frontend-proxy backend held 180 hits versus 19 displayed rows, so other 5xx requests in the window may exist unobserved.
No matched baseline window was supplied, so no before/after comparison or recovery/health certification is possible.
The specific trigger (code defect, dependency fault, or configuration) behind the Charge failure is not established by the permitted telemetry.
next_steps: Enable payment (and checkout) application log collection in the observability backend so Charge failure messages can be read directly.

Pull a complete trace by trace_id 490fdb46cfa2ce55c61bbe602016604e and 124bb098579844844530eaab40293ff1, including the checkout-internal and any payment spans, to confirm the failing span's attributes and messages.
Query payment-side error/exception metrics or logs (e.g. payment container stdout) for the window 1789010952–1789011252 on cluster m0-otel-20260909.
Have a human verify whether payment Charge failures coincide with a currency/transaction-type pattern, given the CAD and USD counters, using data outside the authorized scope.
